Established in 1991 by the visionary Shri Chandraprakash Jain, and joined by his wife Neeta Jain and son CA Akshay Jain, our family-owned venture combines traditional craftsmanship with modern artistry creating bespoke pieces that evoke deep spiritual connections and inspire devotion.

I had the privilege of visiting this studio, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. Chandraprakash Sir has dedicated his life to the art of sculpture, especially in creating divine idols of gods and goddesses. His work reflects not just skill, but a rare, God-gifted talent in design and creativity.

Each piece in his collection is simply breathtaking finely detailed, high-end carvings that showcase exceptional craftsmanship. What stands out most is his deep knowledge and understanding of the subject; every sculpture feels alive with emotion, devotion, and precision.

With his extensive study and experience, he also offers customization, guiding clients with his refined taste and expertise to create pieces that are both unique and meaningful.

He is truly a master of his art. If you take the time to visit his studio and appreciate the intricate details of his carvings, you’ll find yourself immersed in a sense of nostalgia and admiration. It’s not just art, it’s an experience that stays with you.
